controls: Compile the explicit fixture entrypoint from a frozen current source export with COLLECT_PUBLIC_MEDIA_CAPTURE=true.
Apply the maintained admin_cloudflare_assets.py local engine font fallback to the compiled fixture, retain its receipt and bind the helper source plus resulting artifact bytes.
Use cua_repl for every browser navigation, viewport, accessibility observation, network observation and original PNG capture.
Serve only the captured build on IPv4 loopback with a restrictive self-only CSP. Block remote HTTPS before navigating to the app.
Bind the actual served main.dart.js and all observed local response bodies to the build manifest. Save sanitized network statuses and console diagnostics.
Verify the exact expected route and rendered state, inspect each original capture, and preserve failures. No screenshot editing or invented interface is allowed.
Require unchanged source and generated bindings, source/build/runtime hashes, separate visual-review records and complete seven-route coverage.
Mark browser fixture evidence as native_capture_passed=false, native_acceptance=false and provider/hosted/database calls zero only when actually observed.
